convert_tensor_to_meta: convert a torch tensor to a meta tensor while preserving its class and attributes
materialize_meta_tensor: materialize a meta tensor back into an actual tensor on the current device
capture_layer_params_to_meta: capture all parameters and buffers of a PyTorch layer and convert them to meta tensors
restore_layer_on_meta: restore a PyTorch layer's parameters and buffers from meta-tensor metadata onto the meta device
measure_weight_loader_elements: measure the number of elements loaded by a weight loader function using a torch dispatch counter
